phase: research8 phase 2 (A0): stock-only option values against market prices around releases
thesis: Value options from stock behaviour alone (phase 1 distribution, centred so E[S_T] = S). The market price is only what is paid. Trade when price and model value differ; judge by realized payoffs and after-cost P&L.
model: The phase 1 model frozen as best_crps (research8/phase1_frozen.json), walk-forward as in phase 1 (refit each 1 January; original-name training through 2022, all names from 2023). Horizons other than 1/2/5/10/21/42/63 use the nearest fitted horizon (log distance) for shapes, jump tables and HAR coefficients and the exact session count for variances. Robustness only (never selection): the best_tw model and B0.

records.source: research7 quote caches (original names: research7-data-2026-10; expanded names: research7-expanded-2026-10), closing bid/ask and open interest
records.decision_closes: P-4, P-1, P (held through the release) and Q, Q+1 (after the release)
records.expiry: pre-release labels: first expiry with Q <= exdate <= Q + 10 days; post-release labels: first expiry with decision + 5 <= exdate <= decision + 35 days
records.structures: straddle: ATM call and put (strike nearest spot with both sides quoted); strangle: call strictly above spot nearest S(1 + 0.5M), put strictly below nearest S(1 - 0.5M), M = straddle mid / spot
records.liquidity: every leg: bid > 0, mid >= 0.05, open interest >= 10, (ask - bid)/mid <= 0.25
records.exclusions: spot < $10; cash dividend ex-date in (decision, expiry]; any split or data break (log close ratio differs from summed total returns by > 0.02); legs whose mid is at or below intrinsic (no implied vol)
records.holding: to expiry; payoff from the stock close on the last session on or before the expiry date
records.hedge: daily at stock closes with Black-Scholes deltas at each leg's entry implied vol (r = 0, time in sessions / 252), unwound at expiry; hedge cost 2 bp of traded stock notional

signals.rho: market mid of the structure / model value of the structure
signals.rho_rel: rho / median rho of the same name, label and structure at its last <= 8 earlier records whose expiry close is on or before this decision close (need >= 4); uses lagged option prices only

returns: per-share P&L divided by the structure's market mid: direction x (payoff - mid [+ hedge P&L]) - cost x half-spread (entry only; expiry settles) - $0.0130 fees - hedge cost; cost in {0, 25%, 50%, 100%} of the quoted half-spread
rules: label {5} x structure {2} x hedge {hedged, unhedged} x {sell all, buy all, sell rho >= 1.1/1.25/1.5/2.0, buy rho <= 0.9/0.8/0.67/0.5, sell rho_rel >= 1.1/1.25/1.5, buy rho_rel <= 0.9/0.8/0.67} = 320 rules

samples.prior_exposure: Not pristine for option outcomes: research7 sample E (expanded names, 2018-2025) was evaluated once for six earlier hypotheses (pre-release long straddles/strangles exited at P, short 2x iron flies P-4 to Q+4). The phase 2 rules are different (model-conditioned, held to expiry, delta-hedged) but outcomes of related trades on these names were seen.

statistics: Weekly series: each calendar week's return is the mean return of trades decided that week (0 if none). Sharpe = mean / sd x sqrt(52); t = mean / sd x sqrt(weeks). Intervals: 2,000-draw bootstrap over weeks of the trade-level mean (seed 20261004).
freeze_rule: On dev, a rule is eligible if it has >= 200 trades, mean return at 25% cost > 0 with bootstrap lower bound > 0, weekly t at 25% cost >= 3.0, and mean at 25% cost > 0 in both 2018-2020 and 2021-2022. Freeze at most 5 eligible rules with the highest 25%-cost Sharpe, at most one per (label, structure, direction). If none is eligible, nothing is frozen and the round fails.
test_gates: A frozen rule is a strong success if on test: (1) mean at 25% cost > 0 with bootstrap lower bound > 0; (2) annual Sharpe at 25% cost >= 1.0; (3) weekly t at 25% cost >= 2.0; (4) mean at 50% cost > 0. Rules passing (1) but not all four are reported as weak.
outputs: Aggregates only in docs/research8/phase2; trade records private with SHA-256 recorded.
